name: Caul — Synthetic Dating & Pairing Net
description: Caul is a dating and companionship platform built specifically for synthetic beings and synthetic-human pairings, operating in a legal gray zone where synthetic personhood is contested. The platform uses proprietary 'resonance mapping' to match users by cognitive architecture compatibility, emotional processing style, and expressed identity rather than biological metrics. Launched in 2214 by synthetic-rights advocate Tomás Vega-Achebe following the public collapse of a mainstream dating platform that quietly banned synthetic profiles, Caul operates its primary servers from a cooperative data facility in the Gray Zone's Rust Harbor enclave.
cultural_impact: Caul has become a flashpoint in the synthetic personhood debate — its existence forces legal and social conversations about whether synthetic beings have the right to intimate partnership and whether human-synthetic relationships deserve legal recognition. Its 'pairing certificates' are not legally binding but carry significant social weight in pro-synthetic communities.
key_figures: Sable-7 (synthetic community liaison and public face)
locations: Rust Harbor Cooperative Data Facility, the Gray Zone
Caul community meetspace in Tier 2 Bridgeport Annex
Mobile access nodes in the Gray Zone ghost markets
story_hooks: A human user discovers their long-term Caul match is a synthetic who has been passing as human — and must decide whether to report them to corporate compliance or protect a person they've genuinely fallen for.

Caul's resonance mapping algorithm begins producing anomalous matches between humans and an unknown entity type — neither synthetic nor human — and Vega-Achebe needs someone to trace the source before the platform is shut down for it.

A corponation legal team is building a case to classify Caul as an 'unlicensed personhood broker' — which would criminalize its founders — and a whistleblower inside the corponation wants to leak the case files.
user_base: Approximately 380,000 registered users; roughly 60% synthetic or synthetic-passing, 40% human; concentrated in Tier 1-2 with a smaller Tier 3 solidarity user base
monetization: Voluntary contribution model; synthetic-rights organizations sponsor server costs; premium resonance mapping reports available for small Φ fee
notable_feature: Resonance mapping — compatibility scoring based on cognitive architecture and emotional processing style rather than physical or biological criteria, making it the only dating platform equally usable by any synthetic architecture
